fato_historico: 2009: U.S. Army Major Nidal Hasan murders 13 and wounds 32 at Fort Hood, Texas in the deadliest mass shooting at a U.S. military installation.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find stillness amidst the noise of the world. While shadows of past sorrow may echo in history, you are encouraged to radiate compassion and healing light. It is a good time to nurture your spirit, focus on emotional clarity, and let your intuition guide you toward restorative and tranquil experiences.
frase_do_dia: Let your heart be the beacon of peace in a turbulent world.
significado_numero: A powerful cycle representing transformation and the shedding of old layers.
conselho: Prioritize your mental sanctuary and choose kindness in every interaction you have today.
